# telnyx_regulatory_requirements (Data Source)

The regulatory requirements for phone numbers of a country and type.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_action` (String) Action to check requirements for One of `action`, `ordering`, `porting`.
- `filter_country_code` (String) Country code(iso2) to check requirements for
- `filter_phone_number` (String) Phone number to check requirements for
- `filter_phone_number_type` (String) Phone number type to check requirements for One of `local`, `mobile`, `national`, `shared_cost`, `toll_free`.
- `filter_requirement_group_id` (String) ID of requirement group to check requirements for
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `regulatory_requirements` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regulatory_requirements))
